units.source_text: 源氏不许夕雾中将走近紫姬房间。

en.t: Genji would not allow Lieutenant General Yugiri to go near Lady Murasaki's room.

units.source_text: 但小女公子所居之处，并不禁止他去。

en.t: But he did not forbid him from visiting the place where the young princess lived.

units.source_text: 因为他想：我在世之时，不论怎样，都无问题；

en.t: For he thought, while I am alive, whatever happens, there will be no problem;

units.source_text: 但预想我死之后，如果兄妹二人早就相熟，互相了解，则感情总会特别好些。

en.t: but if I think ahead to after my death, if the brother and sister have long been familiar with each other and understand one another, their affection will surely be especially good.

units.source_text: 因此他允许夕雾走进小女公子所居的朝南房间的帘内去，而不许他走进紫姬房间旁边侍女们所居的下房中。

en.t: For this reason he allowed Yugiri to go inside the curtains of the south-facing room where the young princess lived, but did not allow him to enter the lower rooms beside Lady Murasaki's chamber where the serving women stayed.

units.source_text: 但他膝下子女不多，所以对夕雾关怀也很深切。

en.t: Still, he did not have many children of his own, so his concern for Yugiri was also very deep.

units.source_text: 夕雾心地温厚，态度诚实，因此源氏大臣放心地信任他。

en.t: Yugiri was warm-hearted and honest in manner, and so Minister Genji trusted him with peace of mind.

units.source_text: 小女公子年仅八岁，还喜欢弄玩偶。

en.t: The young princess was only eight years old and still liked playing with dolls.

units.source_text: 夕雾看到她那模样，立刻回想起当年和云居雁共玩时的情况，便热心地帮她搭玩偶的房间，不过有时不免心情沮丧。

en.t: Seeing her like that, Yugiri at once remembered how he had once played together with Kumoinokari, and he eagerly helped her set up rooms for the dolls, though at times he could not help feeling dejected.

units.source_text: 他遇到年貌相当的女子，也常常说些调情的话，然而决不使对方认以为真。

en.t: When he met women of suitable age and looks, he often said flirtatious things, yet he never let the other person take them as serious.

units.source_text: 有时觉得这女子全无缺陷，颇可称心，但也努力自制，终于逢场作戏而已。

en.t: Sometimes he thought a woman had no flaws at all and was quite to his liking, but he still made an effort to restrain himself, and in the end it remained no more than a passing game.

units.source_text: 他心中只怀着一大希望，便是早日脱却这件受人轻视的绿袍，升官晋爵，以便与云居雁结婚。

en.t: In his heart he cherished only one great hope: to shed as soon as possible this green robe that made people look down on him, rise in office and rank, and thereby marry Kumoinokari.

units.source_text: 如果强欲成亲，纠缠不休，内大臣定然会让步，把女儿许给他。

en.t: If he had insisted forcefully on the marriage and kept pressing, the Minister of the Center would surely have yielded and given him his daughter.

units.source_text: 但他每逢痛恨之时，总是下个决心：定要内大臣自悟其非，向他认错。

en.t: But whenever he felt bitter resentment, he always made a resolve: he would make the Minister of the Center realize his own wrong and admit his fault to him.

units.source_text: 这决心他永远不忘。

en.t: He never forgot this resolve.

units.source_text: 所以他虽然对云居雁一直不断地表示热烈的爱慕，但对外人绝不露出焦灼的模样。

en.t: Therefore, although he constantly showed passionate love for Kumoinokari, he never revealed any anxious impatience to outsiders.

units.source_text: 因此云居雁的诸兄柏木等常常讨厌夕雾态度冷淡。

en.t: For that reason, Kumoinokari's brothers, including Kashiwagi, often disliked what they saw as Yugiri's cold attitude.

units.source_text: 柏木右中将热恋玉鬘的美貌，但除了那个小侍女见子以外，没有人帮他斡旋，便向夕雾诉苦求助。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Lieutenant General of the Right, was passionately in love with Tamakazura's beauty, but apart from the little maid Miko, no one would act as go-between for him, so he complained to Yugiri and asked for help.

units.source_text: 夕雾冷淡地答道：“别人的事，我不放在心上。”

en.t: Yugiri answered coldly, "Other people's affairs are not something I keep in mind."

units.source_text: 这两人的关系，正像两人的父亲年轻时的关系一样。

en.t: The relationship between these two was exactly like the relationship between their fathers when they were young.
